teaching_separation.astra_interpretation: Treat Plume as the operator who secures the first kill, with a second unit added to finish/protect the follow-up; check whether the DP cost is actually sufficient rather than assuming it is not.
teaching_separation.simulation_observation: SUPPORTED: Plume @[3,5]UP deploys at frame 31 and solo-kills #1 at frame 720 (run-0002). Adding Midnight @[4,5]RIGHT at frame 481 kills both #1 (frame 600) and #2 (frame 780), last-hit both by Plume, with 0.033 DP leftover. DP is sufficient. But the leak set shifts to the outer lanes #4/#5 (leak #4@1132, #5@1282); Plume's 601-frame retreat refunds DP yet the ~2100-frame redeploy cooldown cannot cover those early outer lanes. Overall five-op result did not improve.
teaching_separation.abstract_rule: When a proposed early-kill plan technically works but the leak set merely shifts, check the redeploy cooldown against the new leak frames before adding more damage; DP refund does not buy immediate re-engagement.
